raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different Llama model variants. The x-axis represents the number of completions (k), displayed on a logarithmic scale (base 2) ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick marks at each power of 2. The y-axis represents coverage, on a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.4 to 0.9. Four lines are shown. The first, labeled "Llama-3B," is depicted as a dark blue solid line with filled circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.43 at k=1 and rises steadily to approximately 0.90 at k=256. The second, labeled "Llama-3B + FT," is shown as a dark green dashed line with filled square markers; it starts at approximately 0.48 at k=1 and increases to approximately 0.90 at k=256, generally tracking slightly above the Llama-3B line at lower k values before converging at higher k values. The third, labeled "Llama-1B," is a light blue solid line with open circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.42 at k=1 and rises to approximately 0.88 at k=256, remaining slightly below the 3B variants throughout. The fourth, labeled "Llama-1B + FT," is a light green dashed line with open triangle markers; it starts at approximately 0.46 at k=1 and increases to approximately 0.88 at k=256, following a similar trajectory to the Llama-1B line but slightly higher at lower k values. All four lines show a monotonically increasing trend that decelerates at higher values of k, with the curves appearing to plateau as they approach k=256.
